# Roman Bandurin — Projects Catalog

> Catalog of projects published on GitHub Pages by Roman Bandurin. Each project is
> published from its own repository under its own path; this root site is the directory.

## Documentation

- [Index (HTML)](/): the catalog page
- [AGENTS.md](/AGENTS.md): instructions for agents, storage note about shared origin
- [index.md](/index.md): markdown mirror of the catalog page
- [sitemap.md](/sitemap.md): structured map of agent-readable surfaces
- [sitemap.xml](/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap (root + per-project entries)

## Projects

- [Crypto — Web Crypto API Playground & Agentic Tool Server](/crypto/): browser-based
  cryptography playground (digests, encryption, signatures, key generation) with an
  AI chat and WebMCP tool server. Fully client-side, no backend.
  - [/crypto/llms.txt](/crypto/llms.txt): project LLM directory
  - [/crypto/llms-full.txt](/crypto/llms-full.txt): full project documentation
  - [/crypto/AGENTS.md](/crypto/AGENTS.md): project agent instructions
  - [/crypto/index.md](/crypto/index.md): markdown mirror of the app page
  - [/crypto/openapi.json](/crypto/openapi.json): project API contract
